context.title: Chinatown History and Culture Association: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition D (Changes to Ballot Measure Process)

positions.statement: Chinatown History and Culture Association signed the argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition D in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition E (City Administrator's Authority and Changes to City Contracting)

positions.statement: Chinatown History and Culture Association signed the argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition E and the paid argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition E in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition F (Changes to Executive Branch Management)

positions.statement: Chinatown History and Culture Association signed the argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition F and the paid argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition F in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.
